scope: Controlled UI integration; no inference, Android or operator runtime execution
results: A failed initial history read can reconnect without losing the draft
Production client opens with the real JACO brand, one conversation and no overflow
Desktop and mobile view changes retain the same draft and conversation session
A real SSE event is inserted exactly once in the conversation with its mission
A successful unverified step and a failing step cannot masquerade as verified
A question receives observed run context and does not restart or replace the mission
Evidence opens beside the conversation and identifies its durable source
An event opens the real, deferred Monaco editor for its referenced file
HTML preview runs in an isolated origin and cannot mutate the IDE
An observed file write updates the open preview without reopening it
A live file update preserves a dirty draft, rejects a conflicting save and requires explicit reload
Live connection interruption preserves the draft, exposes uncertainty and reconnects without duplicates
A store restart replays both durable events and the saved encrypted conversation
Lite mission acknowledgements are accepted without claiming completed work
Rejected goal creation keeps the request text and never creates a false activation message
